basic.name: Cloudfencer Art: Starshine
basic.description_template: Deals Physical DMG equal to {{damage}}% of Sushang's ATK to one designated enemy.

skill.name: Cloudfencer Art: Mountainfall
skill.description_template: Deals Physical DMG equal to {{skill_damage}}% of Sushang's ATK to one designated enemy. In addition, there is a 33% chance to trigger "Sword Stance" on the final hit, dealing Physical Additional DMG equal to {{sword_stance}}% of Sushang's ATK to the enemy. If the enemy is inflicted with Weakness Break, "Sword Stance" is guaranteed to trigger.

ultimate.name: Shape of Taixu: Dawn Herald
ultimate.description_template: Deals Physical DMG equal to {{ult_damage}}% of Sushang's ATK to one designated enemy target, and she immediately takes action. In addition, Sushang's ATK increases by {{atk_buff}}% and using her Skill has 2 extra chances to trigger "Sword Stance" for 2 turn(s). "Sword Stance" triggered from the extra chances deals 50% of the original DMG.

talent.name: Dancing Blade
talent.description_template: When an enemy has their Weakness Broken on the field, Sushang's SPD increases by {{spd_buff}}% for 2 turn(s).

technique.name: Cloudfencer Art: Warcry
technique.description: Immediately attacks the enemy. Upon entering battle, Sushang deals Physical DMG equal to 80% of her ATK to all enemies.

2.name: Guileless
2.description: When current HP percentage is 50% or lower, reduces the chance of being attacked by enemies.

4.name: Riposte
4.description: For every Sword Stance triggered, the DMG dealt by Sword Stance increases by 3%. Stacks up to 10 time(s).

6.name: Vanquisher
6.description: After using Basic ATK or Skill, if there are enemies on the field that are Weakness Broken, Sushang's action advances by 15%.

eidolons.name: Cut With Ease
eidolons.description: After using Skill against a Weakness Broken enemy, regenerates 1 Skill Point.

eidolons.name: Refine in Toil
eidolons.description: After Sword Stance is triggered, the DMG taken by Sushang is reduced by 20% for 1 turn.

eidolons.name: Rise From Fame
eidolons.description: Ultimate Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15. Talent Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15.

eidolons.name: Prevail via Taixu
eidolons.description: Skill Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15. Basic ATK Lv. +1, up to a maximum of Lv. 10.

eidolons.name: Dwell Like Water
eidolons.description: Talent's SPD Boost is stackable and can stack up to 2 times. Additionally, after entering battle, Sushang immediately gains 1 stack of her Talent's SPD Boost.
